summary_for_children: Az-Zalzalah says that whoever does even an atom's weight of good will see it, and whoever does an atom's weight of bad will see it.
environment_concept: A symbolic world of tiny particles where each good deed is seen, without depicting the earthquake.
architecture_and_scenery: A microscope-like garden where tiny grains glow.

activities.name: Small deeds
activities.description: Collect tiny good deeds that glow (adaptation).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
